title: Qualify the isolated AC1024 BLOCKGRIPLOCATIONCOMPONENT output profile

sourceRead.observed: The independent JSON read reports EvalExpr major/minor 29/2 for handles 0x111A and 0x111B.

independentOutput.observed: The records with handles 0x111A and 0x111B emit group 98 = 33 and group 99 = 29, followed by group 1 empty, group 70 = 40, group 40 = 0.0, AcDbBlockGripExpr, group 91 = 16 and their UpdatedX/UpdatedY expression.

schemaSource.observed: AcDbEvalExpr_fields reads evalexpr.major/minor as DWG fields, but its DXF branch emits literal group 98 = 33 and group 99 = 29.

source.profileBoundary: The real owner DICTIONARY has three entries and the EvaluationGraph has additional visibility records. This receipt qualifies the exact record body with a singleton EvaluationGraph/DICTIONARY/BLOCK_RECORD route only; it does not admit the mixed source graph.
source.fixturePolicy: The existing DWG was read in place. Test input is authored in C++; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.

implementation.summary: Decode only the exact AC1024 EvalExpr value-code-40 body and BlockGripExpr body. Preserve source DWG EvalExpr 29/2 in the model and emit the DXF schema identifiers 33/29. Admit only the source-backed AC1024 singleton EvaluationGraph route, with each node resolving uniquely to a GripLocationComponent whose node ID matches the graph index. Register one exact CLASS instance and retain fail-closed behavior outside this profile.
implementation.scope: AC1024 DWG source to AC1024 ASCII/Binary DXF output, exactly one GripLocationComponent in a one-node EvaluationGraph and a singleton ACAD_ENHANCEDBLOCK owner dictionary. Other EvalExpr variants, multiple-node graphs, other source/target versions, mixed owner dictionaries and DXF-origin typed/raw replay remain unqualified.

qualification.ascii: PASS: exact emitted EvalExpr/value-pair/BlockGripExpr sequence, remapped object and graph handles, owner DICTIONARY, BLOCK_RECORD edge, CLASS count and fresh import agree.
qualification.binary: PASS: the same exact body and ownership checks pass through Binary DXF output and fresh import.
qualification.valuePair: PASS: only value code 40 with its DXF group 40 payload is admitted; unsupported selector/group combinations remain outside the typed profile.
qualification.canonicalDxfPair: PASS: DXF parsing admits only schema pair 33/29; a locally authored group-98 value 34 remains an opaque, incomplete body.
qualification.gripType: PASS: only source-backed grip type 16 is admitted by this narrow profile.
qualification.nodeRoleAndIdentity: PASS: each singleton graph expression handle resolves once to an admitted GripLocationComponent, and its next-node index matches the child's source node ID.
qualification.unsupportedGraph: PASS refusal: unsupported source EvalExpr version pair, node-ID mismatch, incomplete graph and mixed owner graph do not publish output.

negativeControls: A DWG-source EvalExpr pair other than 29/2 is refused while an existing destination sentinel remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
A graph next-node index that disagrees with the GripLocationComponent node ID is refused while the destination sentinel remains unchanged.
failureAndRetry.retry: After correcting the source pair and graph node ID, retrying on the same adapter succeeds; fresh import returns the emitted 33/29 DXF schema fields and corrected object/graph bindings.
